title: Zahra (s.a) Kay Dil Kay Tukray
body:
Zahra sa Kay Dil Kay Tukray Hain Rait E Karbala Pay(2)
Zainab as Bhi Rorahi Hain(2) Balon Say Muu Chupa Kay,
1) Hathon Mai Khoon E Asghar As Laker Hussain As Bolay (2),
Is Khoon Ko Ma Mola A.S(2),Phekoon Kahan Pe Jaa Kay.
2) Zaalim Ne Saang Maari Qabr E Batool (S.A) (2),
Barchhi Lagi Hai Haaye(2) Tasveer E Mustafa (S.A.W) Pe
3) Kardyal Jawaa'n Ka Lasha Aur Baap Ki Zae'efi (2)
Abbas (A.S) Kese Laaon (2) Akbar (A.S) Ko Ma Utha Kay
4) Ik Raat Ka Dulha Baraat Lutt Chuki Ha (2)
Tukray Bikhar Chukay Hain (2) Har Simt Innama Kay
5)Bazoo Bhi Katt Gaye Hain Dantoo'n Ma Mashk Thaamay(2)
Taqdeer Ro Rahi Hai(2) Ghazi A.S Teri Wafa Pay
